scope: Read-only official-source compatibility research and isolated install plan; no package installation or runtime mutation performed.

target.training: Qwen3-1.7B QLoRA NF4, FP16, LoRA r8/r16, AdamW8bit, assistant-only labels

install.isolation: Create a separate Python 3.12 venv; do not change packages in the active run.
install.order: Install exact Torch CUDA 13.0 trio from the cu130 index first, then requirements-pinned.txt from PyPI.

compatibility_basis: Official Unsloth pyproject has a cu130-torch2110 extra and matching CUDA 13.0 Torch 2.11.0 trio; it also excludes CUDA-incompatible xformers combinations through platform-specific extras.
Official Unsloth-Zoo metadata permits Torch >=2.4,<2.15; Transformers 5.16.1 is within the inspected current compatibility interval.
Official Qwen3 training documentation includes Unsloth-based Qwen3 fine-tuning and 4-bit loading examples; the cited example is not itself a benchmark guarantee for this exact T4/model/configuration.

training_lineage.fresh_r8: Initialize from the pinned base revision with fresh r8 LoRA and new AdamW8bit state.
training_lineage.fresh_r16: Initialize from the pinned base revision with fresh r16 LoRA and new AdamW8bit state.
training_lineage.old_adapter_r16: PEFT weights may be considered only as a warm start after exact model revision, target modules and adapter tensor shapes are verified; this does not resume the old optimizer state.
training_lineage.old_adapter_to_r8: Do not load the existing r16 adapter into r8; ranks are structurally different.
training_lineage.optimizer_resume: Not compatible as an exact continuation: prior optimizer is regular AdamW while this experiment uses AdamW8bit. Start a clearly labeled branch with fresh optimizer state.

data_contract: Keep the existing assistant-only supervision mask and exact row stream. This receipt does not authorize changing dataset selection, labels, or evaluation access.
fallback: If the pinned Unsloth CUDA 13 extra cannot resolve cleanly in the isolated venv, stop and capture resolver diagnostics; do not replace Torch in the active runtime. A separate benchmark fallback may use the already validated non-Unsloth trainer, clearly labeled as a different benchmark, not as Unsloth results.
limitations: Current upstream metadata and PyPI release pages establish package/version compatibility, not runtime success on the particular Colab image or T4 driver.
Re-resolve/install only in the disposable venv, record pip freeze and the installed wheel hashes before benchmarking.
No GPU, model, dataset, or training job was run for this compatibility receipt.
